question: Guru Bipin Singh won various accolades in which dance form?
solution:
The correct option is __**Manipuri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Guru Bipin Singh **was a renowned exponent of the **Manipuri dance** form.
 
• In **1966**, he received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
• **Manipuri is a classical dance form** that originated in the northeastern state of** Manipur**, India.
 
• It is known for its graceful and lyrical movements, devotional themes, and vibrant costumes.
 
• Guru Bipin Singh made significant contributions to the promotion and preservation of Manipuri dance and received several accolades for his dedication to the art form.
